subject: Execute visible Westside Watch homepage after worker import repair
body: Use the live Penpot MCP and run the current deterministic Penpot homepage construction now. Create a NEW editable board named 02 — Westside Watch Homepage v0.3 — VISIBLE. It must visibly contain a Living Paper background, Ink masthead, First Light Gold rule, large hero title, Watch Night 5:8 visual field, Morning Gold accent, and editorial passage. Do not stop at a blank board. Return the real created board id, export that exact board as PNG, and require visual verification. If any tool/API call fails, return the exact error rather than guessing.
design_brief: Visible construction acceptance test. The board must not be blank. Canonical Westside Watch palette only: Living Paper #FAF9F5, Ink Black #252525, First Light Gold #A2872A, Watch Night #102A43, Morning Gold #D2BC69. Editable native Penpot shapes/text.
